name: Lizzie Smithson Commits Intellectual Property Theft
source:
Lizzie Smithson meets various characters from popular culture, including Sly Cooper, Disney's Robin Hood, Heathcliff the Cat, and Clefable/Clefairy from Pokemon.

[Edited from [url=https://godahl.itch.io/lizzie-smithson-commits-intellectual-property-theft] itch.io[/url]]
